name: The Peregrination of Criselda dela Vega
source:
Stanley has just turned 40; and on his way to a brand-new bar, he meets his old college friend, Criselda, who is of the same age. He gets roped into her journey that will pave the way for their bubbling feelings.

[From [url=https://dagitabsoft.itch.io/the-peregrination-of-criselda-dela-vega]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
斯坦利刚满40岁；在去一家全新酒吧的路上，他遇到了同龄的大学老朋友克里塞尔达。他被卷入了她的旅程，这将为他们热烈的感情铺平道路。

[来自[url=https://dagitabsoft.itch.io/the-peregrination-of-criselda-dela-vega]itch.io[/url]]
